methods.name: Sen12Landslides processing pipeline (including NDVI-based dating algorithm)
methods.summary: A multi-temporal, multi-modal processing pipeline that integrates landslide inventories with Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2, and Copernicus DEM data. It includes a custom NDVI-based dating algorithm to identify landslide event dates and a self-training refinement process using deep learning models to improve label quality.
